info.name: tyntec Phone Number Intelligence Number Information Number Verification API

params.name: number
params.description: The phone number to verify, in international E.164 format without the leading plus.

params.name: criteria
params.description: Name of a previously created criteria template to evaluate the number against.

items.docs: Validates the given phone number (E.164, without a leading +) against a named criteria template. Returns whether the number passes, plus the underlying number intelligence used to decide - validity, reachability (active subscriber), line type, operator, country, MCC/MNC, and disposable-number flags.
